Academic Literature and Public Records are supported by the stated source types; digital-forensic financial-fraud auditing supports the category/investigation type. No inference of new datasets or validated operational tools.

current_usefulness.label: currently_useful
current_usefulness.material_inspected: Complete current PDF-matched abstract reread after all six gates passed. Actual PDF front matter, byline, issue/year and opening prose checked mechanically; full paper not scientifically assessed.
current_usefulness.present_day_application: Context for planning digital-forensic capability and evidentiary practices in public-sector financial-fraud investigations, especially institutional/legal barriers in Ghana and comparable settings.
current_usefulness.limitations: Literature/policy synthesis, not a deployed system evaluation. Claims about technology benefits or reduced revenue loss remain proposals; transfer to other jurisdictions requires local legal/institutional assessment.
